packMeta.name: Service Desk (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey customer support helpdesk with ticket triage queue, 1-click escalations, bug tracker, upvotable feature board, refunds desk, live NPS calculator, and searchable knowledge base. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 7 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
